subject: Supplier onboarding: tax identity and EIN confirmation for Solstice AI
messages:
From: Sara Chen <accounts@solstice-ai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding - Solstice AI payment setup

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the warm welcome during last week’s partner call. We’re ready to get set up in your procurement system so we can start billing next month. I’ve attached our invoice template to speed the PO/payment mapping (see attachment).

Quick checklist we can provide immediately:
- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if foreign)
- EIN confirmation (SS-4 or IRS CP575 or bank ACH prenote)
- Company legal name and DBA mapping

I’ve attached the invoice template for your team. If you can confirm which tax form you need and any additional evidence required for EIN, we’ll return the documents in the next business day.

Thanks,
Sara Chen
Manager, Finance Operations
Solstice AI
accounts@solstice-ai.com
[Attachment: solstice_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <accounts@solstice-ai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - Solstice AI payment setup

Thanks Sara — welcome!

For Redwood procurement the standard evidence we need to clear PO creation is:
1) Completed W-9 if Solstice is a US taxable entity (preferred). If not US, a completed W-8BEN-E plus US withholding instructions.
2) EIN confirmation: acceptable documents are IRS CP575, SS-4 acknowledgement, IRS 147C, or a bank ACH prenote showing the EIN.
3) Clarify legal name vs DBA (we saw Solstice AI used externally). Please confirm the legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax documents.

Please do not send bank account details via plain email — we will provide a secure upload link if you need to submit ACH details.

Jordan — tagging you to confirm any additional procurement checklist items or expedited routing if their first invoice timing is tight.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[signature]

From: Sara Chen <accounts@solstice-ai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - Solstice AI payment setup

Hi Naomi — thanks, appreciate the checklist.

Attached are:
- Completed W-9 (solstice_w9_filled.pdf)
- Scan of EIN confirmation (SS-4 acknowledgement) — solstice_ein_ss4_scan.jpg

Notes:
- Legal name on SS-4 and W-9 is "Solstice Systems, Inc." We operate as "Solstice AI" commercially.
- If you need a CP575 or a notarized copy, we can request a CP575 from the IRS but it may take longer; SS-4 confirmation was what our tax counsel recommended as acceptable for most buyers.

Please confirm if the attached work for your PO gate or if you prefer a CP575/147C instead. We can also provide a state business registration snapshot if that helps.

Thanks,
Sara Chen
Accounts Payable
Solstice Systems, Inc. (d/b/a Solstice AI)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <accounts@solstice-ai.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - Solstice AI payment setup

Hi Sara — thanks for sending both files. Quick review notes from procurement:

- W-9 looks complete and lists legal name as "Solstice Systems, Inc." Good.
- The SS-4 scan you provided is partially redacted and we can’t fully match the EIN digits to the W-9. For our PO system we need unambiguous evidence tying the EIN to the legal name.

Acceptable/fast options (pick one):
- Clear CP575 or IRS 147C letter (official IRS letter confirming EIN)
- Unredacted SS-4 acknowledgement scan showing EIN and company name
- Bank ACH prenote or voided check (with EIN) — secure upload only
- State business registration showing EIN (if available)

If you can resend a clearer scan of the SS-4 or provide a CP575/147C we can clear the vendor record same day and issue a PO. If the official IRS letter is delayed, a notarized SS-4 or a bank prenote will also work. I’ve attached our quick procurement evidence checklist for vendor teams.

Jordan Blake
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)]
